extDescription.message: Click any text to inspect its font: family, size, weight, line height, letter spacing and color.
extDescription.description: Add-on description shown in the add-ons manager and on AMO.

copyHint.description: Tooltip on a value in the panel.

close.description: Tooltip of the panel close button.

footerHint.message: Esc to exit · click a value to copy
footerHint.description: Hint at the bottom of the panel.

computedLabel.description: Label of the row showing the browser-computed color (for color-mix(), light-dark()…).

colorSourceInline.description: Color comes from the element's style attribute.

colorInheritedFrom.description: Color is inherited from an ancestor element.

colorSourceDefault.description: No CSS rule sets the color.

switchToCompact.description: Tooltip of the panel button that switches to the compact view.

switchToFull.description: Tooltip of the panel button that switches to the full view.

openSettings.description: Tooltip of the panel button that opens the add-on options.

optionDisplayMode.description: Options page: title of the display mode setting.

modeFullDesc.message: Text preview, every value with its conversions (rem, em, ratio), the full font-family stack, and where the color is defined.

optionRowsDesc.description: Options page: explanation of the rows section.

rowPreview.description: Options page: checkbox for the large text preview at the top of the full panel.

noRowsSelected.message: No rows selected. Choose them in the settings (⚙).
